A towering spectral sentinel called forth when a bearer of the §5Eternal Guardian's Band§r falls in battle. Bound to the place of death, it patrols the perimeter of its master's tombstone without ever despawning.

§6Allegiance & Behavior§r
• §aMaster:§r Completely docile. Recognizes its summoner and allows them to freely reclaim their grave.
• §cIntruders:§r Mercilessly hostile to any other player or monster that approaches the tombstone.

§6Combat Tactics§r
Immune to all projectile attacks—arrows, tridents, and fireballs do nothing. You have to fight it up close in melee. It hits hard and cannot be knocked back.

When slain in melee by a player, it drops its severed §5Head§r (100% chance), the core component for the §5Eternal Guardian Mask§r.
